purpose: Review changes to the review workflow against its maintained plan, and assess other changes for bounded source-level defects. This is not the complete specialist-review profile.

criteria.description: The review-only workflow declares read-only GitHub access and does not enable repair, approval, or merge publication capabilities.
criteria.evidence_requirement: Cite the relevant workflow or helper changes against the maintained review-only authority boundary. Static review is not a runtime containment claim.

criteria.description: Changes to review preparation or reporting preserve the distinction between prepared facts, model claims, execution evidence, acceptance readiness, and human merge authority.
criteria.evidence_requirement: Cite relevant changed validation/reporting behavior and identify missing proof explicitly. Do not certify all of the broader plan or unspecified change requirements.

criteria.description: The changed source has no identified material contradiction with the explicitly configured review purpose and criterion sources.
criteria.evidence_requirement: Provide bounded source citations and explain uncertainties; an absence of findings does not demonstrate runtime correctness.
